_about: Śrāddha rules. The tithi of death governs; the day is the one whose aparāhṇa holds that tithi longest. Special Śrāddhas of the Pitṛ Pakṣa are listed with the rule that dates each.

basis.note: Aparāhṇa-vyāpinī tithi. Where the tithi holds the aparāhṇa of two days, the day holding more of it is taken; ties go to the first day.
The dark fortnight of Bhādrapada in amānta reckoning, which is Āśvina in pūrṇimānta reckoning.

paksha_rule.note: A death on a tithi of either pakṣa has its Pitṛ Pakṣa Śrāddha on the same tithi number.

basis.note: Shown with both candidates when an adhika month is involved.

special.name: Avidhavā Navamī, Mātṛ Navamī
special.for: women of the family who died before their husbands

special.name: Maghā Śrāddha
special.for: Maghā, whose deity is the Pitṛs

special.name: Caturdaśī Śrāddha, Ghāta Caturdaśī
special.for: those who died by weapons or accidents

special.name: Sarvapitṛ Amāvāsyā, Mahālaya
special.for: every ancestor, and any whose tithi is not known

special.name: Gajacchāyā Yoga
special.for: listed by Drik among Śrāddha days

basis.note: The rule that dates it is not yet retrieved; it is listed, not computed.

occasions_96.note: The five uncomputed families need their tithi lists retrieved from a source before they are dated.
